violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED RODENT INFESTATION DURING INSPECTION AND NOTED THE FOLLOWING: -RODENT CHEW MARKS ON MULTIPLE BAGS OF FOOD IN THE DRY STORAGE -DROPPINGS ON FOOD CONTAINERS IN DRY STORAGE -DROPPINGS INSIDE CONTAINER OF COCONUT POWDER -DROPPINGS ON A FOOD PREP COUNTER -DROPPINGS ON SHELVING AT COOKLINE -DROPPINGS INSIDE POTS AND PANS AT COOKLINE -INSIDE THE CUPBOARD WITH SINGLE SERVICE NAPKINS AND ON NAPKIN BAGS. OBSERVED LIVE COCKROACH ON COOKLINE FLOOR
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. FACILITY MUST OBTAIN AN EMERGENCY PEST CONTROL SERVICE AND TREATED FOR RODENTS AND COCKROACHES AT MINIMUM. YOU MAY NOT REQUEST TO REOPEN UNTIL THIS SERVICE IS OBTAINED AND I AM PROVIDED WITH THE REPORT. YOU MUST GET FREQUENT PEST CONTROL SERVICES AND FOLLOW ALL RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE SERVICE. PLEASE NOTE THAT THE PIC CALLED FOR PEST CONTROL DURING THE INSPECTION AND THE COMPANY STATED THEY HAVE NOT RECEIVED TREATMENT SINCE JANUARY OR FEBRUARY. IN ADDITION, GETTING PEST CONTROL DOES NOT FIX AN INFESTATION IF YOU STILL MAINTAIN THE CURRENT HARBORAGE CONDITIONS.

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Harborage conditions exist. OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING: -GREASE ALONG THE FLOOR UNDER THE EQUIPMENT ON THE COOKLINE. -GREASE ON THE EQUIPMENT AT THE COOKLINE -FOIL AND CARDBOARD BEING USED TO LINE SHELVING -SIGNIFICANT AMOUNT OF FOOD AND SPICES LEFT OPEN ON SHELVING -CHEWING ON FOOD PACKAGES
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. ALL HARBORAGE CONDITIONS LISTED ABOVE MUST BE CLEANED. ALL AREAS MENTIONED DURING THE INSPECTION MUST BE CLEANED AND FREE OF DEBRIS AND BUILD-UP. ALL FOIL AND CARDBOARD REMOVED AND ALL FOOD COVERED. THIS MUST BE DONE BEFORE REQUESTING TO REOPEN.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED ICE CREAM SCOOP STORED IN ROOM TEMPERATURE WATER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. -EHS REVIEWED PROPER IN-USE UTENSIL STORAGE. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE REMOVE CONTAINER OF WATER AND CHANGE OUT SCOOP.
